heroHeadline: Iran-US Deal Impasse: Tentative MOU Unsigned as Trump Withholds 'Final Determination'
heroSubtitle: From Cyrus the Great's Achaemenid Empire (550 BCE) through the 1979 Islamic Revolution to the post-war Islamic Republic under Mojtaba Khamenei — now at the most critical juncture since the nuclear standoff began: negotiators agreed a 60-day MOU framework on May 28 to extend the ceasefire and launch nuclear talks, but Trump emerged from a Situation Room meeting on May 29 without signing, Iran denied any finalized deal, and 40+ million Iranians face absolute poverty as the 'economic war' enters its most acute phase.
